name: ringside-glm53
description: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 on 4x DGX Spark (switchless ring, b12x kernels). GLP-44 steering via the recipe's own SWITCHLESS_WEIGHTLESS_DIR variant; TP4 only.

self.note: prepare.py fetches the pinned GLP-44 vector (revision ef85b016, sha256 0ccce6b7...), rebuilds the patched model.py, and writes DIR/control.gguf + DIR/model.py + receipt. Set SWITCHLESS_WEIGHTLESS_DIR=DIR in the TP4 site file; every rank mounts DIR read-only and gets WEIGHTLESS_STEER_PATH=/opt/weightless/control.gguf, WEIGHTLESS_STEER_ALPHA=2.0, WEIGHTLESS_STEER_HOOK=post_layer.

glp.note: Steering is TP4-only and off by default; the rank stops on any vector/alpha/hook/layer/topology mismatch (fail-closed).

verify.note: Every rank must log it at boot; its absence means the stock profile is serving.
